title: The Old Lighthouse
text:
Maria had lived in the small village for forty years. Every evening she walked to the old lighthouse and looked at the sea. Nobody remembered when it had last been used. One night, she noticed a light flashing far out on the water.

The next morning, she told the fishermen what she had seen. They laughed at first, but one of them agreed to check. He returned with a small wooden box that had washed ashore. Inside was a letter addressed to her, written by her brother many years before. Maria held the letter for a long time without opening it.

questions.text: Where did Maria walk every evening?
What was inside the wooden box?
Why did Maria hold the letter without opening it?
options: She was perhaps afraid of what it might say
She wanted to give it to the fishermen

questions.text: What can be inferred about the fishermen's reaction to Maria's story?
options: They were doubtful at first but became willing to help
They were angry that she had told them
They had already seen the light themselves

paragraph_translations: Maria tinha vivido na pequena aldeia durante quarenta anos. Todas as noites ela caminhava até o velho farol e olhava para o mar. Ninguém se lembrava de quando ele fora usado pela última vez. Certa noite, ela notou uma luz piscando ao longe, no meio da água.

Na manhã seguinte, ela contou aos pescadores o que tinha visto. Eles riram no início, mas um deles concordou em verificar. Ele voltou com uma pequena caixa de madeira que tinha chegado à praia. Dentro havia uma carta endereçada a ela, escrita pelo seu irmão muitos anos antes. Maria segurou a carta por muito tempo sem abri-la.
